messages:
evelyn: thinking of setting up a retro projector in the mezz for a chill Sunday mini-lan? small, 3–4 stations, bring consoles or rom-less devices.
noah: huge yes. i can bring my SNES mini and a handful of cartridges.
li: projector power? we only have that one outlet by the plant. who can bring a long surge?
omar: i've got a 6m heavy-duty strip and a 15ft extension. will label it.
tess: i'm less about consoles, more about snacks. will bring popcorn and vegan brownies. :popcorn: :brown_heart: 
evelyn: love it. projector prefers 1080p, so HDMI adapters handy if anyone's on older gear.
noah: i have an HDMI-to-AV converter for the ancient arcade cabinet. worked last time.
li: quick PSA: if you connect your laptop to the mezz switch, disable internet sharing or you'll confuse DHCP. happened before.
li: tiny command for mac folks if wifi shenanigans show up:
```
sudo ifconfig en0 down && sudo ifconfig en0 up
```
omar: i'll bring cable ties and gaffer tape for tidy runs and taped labels.
calendar-bot: "Retro Mezz Mini-LAN" created by evelyn for Sun 4:00 PM - 8:00 PM. Location: Mezzanine B.
evelyn: thanks bot. also making a tiny signup google sheet - link in thread when it's up.
tess: poll: do we want a friendly highscore leaderboard or just freeplay? :trophy: :thinking:
noah: leaderboard but no pressure. small prize: 1 free drink token.
li: i'm down for leaderboard. i call the first slot for SNES Mario Kart time trials.
omar: note for projector: bring a spare HDMI cable. don't trust setup karma.
eil: (oops wrong channel)
evelyn: @snack-bot can you remind people to wash their hands before handling controllers? :grimacing:
snack-bot: reminder scheduled: "Wash hands + sanitize controllers" 30 minutes before event.
tess: also, who can do quick teardown so we don't leave the mezz a mess? volunteers?
noah: i'll stay to help pack.
li: me too, till 9pm.
evelyn: perfect. i'll drop the sheet and @everyone ping Friday with final list. bring systems, power bricks, and good vibes. :sparkles:
